toolsDocumentDescription: Document lifecycle operations. Actions: create(), remove(), rename(), move(), get_tree(), list().
toolsExportDescription: Export operations. Actions: md(id), html(id), preview(id), docx(id, output path), sy(id) -> .sy.zip, md-zip(id), data() -> full workspace backup.
toolsFileDescription: Workspace file operations (paths relative to workspace; debugging/log reading only — never use for workspace data). Actions: list(path, limit), read(path, offset, limit), write(path, data), delete(path), rename(old, new), copy(src, dst), grep(pattern, path), find(path), stat(path).
toolsFrontendDescription: Frontend UI interactions. Actions: notify(message, type).
toolsHistoryDescription: Document version history management. Actions: list(), revert(), compare().
toolsHttpRequestDescription: Send custom HTTP requests. Actions: request(url, method, headers, body).
toolsImportDescription: Import operations (absolute local paths). Actions: md(notebook, path, targetPath?), sy(notebook, path, targetPath?), data(path).
toolsInboxDescription: Inbox management (cloud-clipped web pages, messages, and audio/video/file attachments; requires subscription). Actions: list(page=1), get(id), convert(ids, notebook, path=/, remove_after=true) — converts one or more shorthands into local documents under the target notebook, deleting the cloud originals on success.
toolsNotebookDescription: Notebook management and configuration. Actions: list(), create(name), get_conf(id), set_conf(id, conf), remove(id), status(id).
toolsQuestionDescription: Prompt user for questions/confirmation. Actions: ask(questions, submit_button_text).
toolsReadSkillDescription: Read the full workflow document of a specified custom Skill under data/storage/ai/agent/skills. Supports reading sub-file paths.
toolsRefDescription: Reference/backlink operations. Actions: backlinks(id, keyword?, sort?), mentions(id, keyword?, sort?), refresh(id).
toolsRepoDescription: Cloud repository endpoint management. Actions: list(), get(id), remove(id), push().
toolsSearchDescription: Full-text search, semantic search, and asset content search in notebooks. Actions: fulltext(query), semantic(query), asset(query), getasset(path).
toolsSelectorInfo: Select the tools that AI can use. AI will automatically determine when to use these tools based on the conversation context.
toolsSelectorSearchPlaceholder: Search tools by name or description...
toolsSkillDescription: Knowledge base / skill management. Actions: list(), get(id), remove(id), save(id, name, content).
toolsSqlDescription: Query Siyuan database directly via SQL. Actions: query(sql), refresh().
toolsSyncDescription: Data sync operations. Actions: perform() (full upload+download), upload(), download(), status().
toolsSystemDescription: System info. Actions: version(), current_time(), workspace().
toolsTagDescription: Tag management. Actions: list(), remove(tag), rename(old, new).
toolsTemplateDescription: Template management. Actions: search(keyword?), get(path), remove(path), render(path, id), save_as(id, name, overwrite?), create(name, content, overwrite?).
toolsUnzipDescription: Extract a zip archive within the workspace (workspace-relative paths).
toolsWebFetchDescription: Fetch web page content and convert to markdown. Actions: fetch(url, use_webview=false).
toolsWebSearchDescription: Search the web using search engines. Actions: search(query).
